intro: Farming and tourism support the economy of Saint Vincent and the Grenadines.

chapters.title: How it earns
text: Bananas, arrowroot and vegetables are grown. Luxury tourism on Mustique and yachting in the Grenadines bring visitors. Argyle International Airport opened in 2017.

chapters.title: Fishing
text: Bequia has a small traditional whaling quota.

keyTerms.meaning: A starch used in food and paper.

cardGroups.intro: Some of the things Saint Vincent and the Grenadines makes and sells to the world.
